text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Military ruler General Sani Abacha, at a post-budget dinner held at the weekend in the capital Abuja, charges ministries and government agencies to vigorously pursue executing the 1997 fiscal budget.
- Former Tanzanian president Julius Nyerere has arrived Abuja to receive the African Leadership Prize award named after the late independence president of Nigeria, Nnamdi Azikiwe.
- Three-man African team invited by the military government to assess human rights situation in Nigeria has started work.
- Leader of Nigeria's umbrella opposition group NADECO (National Democratic Coalition) successfully undergoes neck operation, six weeks after heart surgery.
